name: Computer Use Helpers
description: Compositor-side helpers for driving a GNOME/Wayland desktop from an agent: screenshots, window list/geometry/control, pointer position, clipboard, an on-screen activity border, and a human-only halt keybinding. session-modes includes unlock-dialog DELIBERATELY: the tools keep answering while the screen is locked, so an agent run does not silently die the moment the lock engages. Independent of (and coexists with) migration-helpers@tristan.local: different UUID, bus name, schema, no shared state.
